kinds: computed by the validation project from the publisher's files

published.title: Published depth, largest pixel in the cell
published.semantics: largest depth the publisher's files hold for a pixel whose centre is in the cell

no_curve_share.title: Flooded pixels without a curve, share
no_curve_share.semantics: share of the cell's pixels flooded at this return period that get no curve under crc-sdk's rules (fewer than four depths, equal depths, a decreasing depth)

no_curve_land.title: Flooded land without a curve (fewer than four depths), share
no_curve_land.semantics: share of the cell's pixels flooded at this return period that have a depth at fewer than four return periods and so get no curve; none of them is permanent water

no_curve_water.title: Water bodies without a curve (equal or decreasing depths), share
no_curve_water.semantics: share of the cell's pixels flooded at this return period whose depths are all equal or decrease, and so get no curve; these lie in the publisher's permanent water

not_converged.title: Pixels the fit does not converge on
not_converged.semantics: pixels that have depths at four or more return periods, not all equal and not decreasing, for which crc-sdk's output has no curve; the same at every return period

dry_curve.title: Dry in the published map, curve gives 0.1 m or more
dry_curve.semantics: pixels with no published depth at this return period whose fitted curve gives 0.1 m or more there

below_zero.title: Curve below zero
below_zero.semantics: pixels whose fitted curve is below 0 m at this return period

misfit.title: Largest distance between curve and published depth
misfit.semantics: largest absolute difference between the fitted curve and the published depth among the cell's fitted pixels flooded at this return period

deep.title: Pixels deeper than 10 m
deep.semantics: pixels whose published depth at this return period is above 10 m

deep_in_mask.title: Pixels deeper than 10 m inside JRC's spurious-depth mask
deep_in_mask.semantics: pixels above 10 m at this return period that lie in the publisher's spurious-depth mask

water_share.title: Flooded pixels that are permanent water, share
water_share.semantics: share of the cell's pixels flooded at this return period that lie in the publisher's permanent-water layer, where the maps hold a patch value

inputs.sha256_of: the list of file names and their sha256
